_instructions: To add a new announcement: copy an entry in the 'items' array, update the fields, and save. Sort by date (newest first). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave 'link' and 'linkText' as empty strings if there is no button link.

items.title: Welcome to the 2026–2027 Season!
items.body: First meeting is Wednesday, September 26th after school (3:00 PM) in Room 918 (Mr. Blok's room). Bring a notebook, pen and the signed permission form. Food will be provided. Get ready to meet new and exciting people!

items.title: First Tournament of this Season
items.body: Our first tournament of the season is GGSA Debate 2: Parli Congress on Saturday, September 26, at San Ramon Valley High School in Danville! Come compete, build your skills, and kick off the season with the team—everyone should join!

items.title: Club Fair at San Marin
items.body: We will be at the Club Fair in the Quad, on Wednesday, September 16th in the Quad during lunch. Come by to learn more about the club, meet the team, and sign up!
